title: What You’ve Mastered 🧠
description: Review the entire course journey: from Python basics to advanced SQL and pandas projects.

slides.title: Congratulations! 🎉
slides.content:
# You Are Now a Data Analyst

You started with zero knowledge and have journeyed through:
- Python fundamentals and data structures
- Pandas for data manipulation and visualization
- SQL for querying databases
- Connecting Python and SQL
- Real‑world data analysis projects

Take a moment to appreciate how far you’ve come. The skills you now possess are **highly valued** in every industry.

slides.title: Chapter 1‑2: Foundations 🐍
slides.content:
## Python & Data Types
- Variables, numbers, strings, booleans
- Control flow: if/elif/else, for, while
- Lists, dictionaries, and nesting

You can now write Python programs to solve problems and manipulate data.

quizData.question: Which data structure is best for storing key‑value pairs?
quizData.explanation: Dictionaries store mappings from keys to values.

slides.title: Chapter 5‑8: Pandas & Visualization 📊
slides.content:
## Data Manipulation Pro
- Series and DataFrame creation and indexing
- Data cleaning: missing values, duplicates, types, outliers
- Filtering, sorting, grouping, pivot tables
- Line, bar, scatter, histogram, box plots

You can load messy data, clean it, and produce insightful visualizations.

slides.title: Chapter 9‑12: SQL & Integration 🗄️
slides.content:
## The Database Expert
- SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY
- Aggregate functions, GROUP BY, HAVING
- JOINs (INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL, SELF)
- Connecting pandas to SQL: read_sql, to_sql, parameterized queries

You can query relational databases, combine data across tables, and bridge SQL with pandas.

quizData.question: Which clause filters groups after aggregation?
quizData.explanation: HAVING is the filter for grouped data.

slides.title: Chapter 13‑14: Full Projects 🏆
slides.content:
## Real‑World Application
- Load data from CSV and SQLite
- Clean and merge multiple data sources
- Perform business analysis
- Create a final report with visualizations and recommendations

You’ve completed an end‑to‑end data analysis project.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Your Learning Never Stops

Revisit earlier chapters when you need a refresher. The best data analysts are always curious and keep building.

slides.title: Self‑Assessment 🏋️
slides.content:
Rate yourself on a scale 1‑5 for each skill:
- Python basics
- Pandas DataFrames
- Data cleaning
- Data visualization
- SQL queries
- Merging data sources
- Building reports

Identify the 2 areas where you feel least confident and plan to practice them.

slides.title: You’ve Built an Amazing Foundation 🎓
slides.content: Now, let’s talk about how to showcase these skills to the world.
